review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability; this harness derives every field from the recorded log, production discovery of $CS_GAME_DIR, and a second production run of cs_app::stunts::survey_retail_stunt_reward over every reader archive of the installation (reward-census.json). Claim is implemented only: the reward/repeat SURFACE is measured, but no file records WHAT a stunt paid or WHETHER a repeat traversal pays again, so RetailStuntRewardSurvey::reward_is_measured() and repeat_is_measured() are false and no original rule is claimed. LIMITS OF WHAT WAS MEASURED, each outside this task's scope and recorded in docs/findings/2026-10-02-t464-stunt-reward-and-repeat.md: (1) no original executable was run, so nothing here is evidence of the original's runtime behaviour — whether a completed stunt paid anything and whether a second traversal paid again are unknown; (2) the zone-crossing predicate, the direction and clearance rules and the actor a crossing is credited to are unmeasured (tasks #465 and the F42 rule work); (3) the `score_*` table is a multiplayer match scoreboard, and whether any single-player stunt ever touched it is not recorded; (4) the `player.zrd` member name is carried twice in the global reader (the score table and an unrelated ANIMATION_DEFINITIONS record), and the score measurement is the declaration-order match the production reader selects; (5) fame/cash counters and linked scrapbook media are outside this task (F43/F47). `unknowns` is empty because the measurement itself has nothing unresolved: every objective key, every objective block key, every stunt-condition key and every score entry the survey reports was read to its end. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass.
